## History

During [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and Diana's door-to-door canvassing along the [Newbridge](../codex/places.md#newbridge) road for the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) Village [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvers), they made a stop at the Andrews residence. While there, the pessimistic [Eliza](../character/eliza-andrews.md) refused to make any contribution to their cause.

_Sources: [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P0](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0000), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P12](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0012), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P16](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0016), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P30](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0030)_
